messages:
zoe_pm: quick kickoff
Proposal: introduce 'alias-shadow' pattern for catalog migrations. Instead of immediate pin swaps, create an alias (model:vCurrent -> alias:name) and shadow traffic to vCandidate. Allows gradual validation and simpler rollbacks. Wanted: product policy on alias lifetime + billing credits during shadow. thoughts?
dan_eng: I like alias shadowing. Implementation notes: routing layer already supports feature gates, we can add alias resolution. Shadowing should be opt-in per-tenant. Need to ensure KV cache isolation for shadowed requests to avoid noisy neighbor effects.
mira_csm: customer view: need in-console visibility (alias status, %shadowed, perf delta). Billing: small token credit during shadow window is fine. Enterprise customers might want manual approval before any alias creation.
leo_sre: ops constraints: tracing tag alias.shadow=<id>, synthetic canary traffic to validate path. If shadowed traffic induces higher error rate we must auto-stop shadowing and page. Also add a global abort switch. Latency SLO regression trigger: p95 +20% sustained 30m -> abort.
dan_eng: propose phases: 1) create alias (no traffic change, just resolution), 2) 1% shadow for 48h, 3) 10% ramp for 24h, 4) optional canary 100% for 1h, 5) final switch. Config example in PRD: `{"alias":"transcribe-stable","from":"v1.3","to":"v2.0","phases":[{"pct":0.01,"dur_h":48},{"pct":0.10,"dur_h":24},{"pct":1.0,"dur_h":1}]}`
zoe_pm: product gates: - self-serve: auto alias unless opt-out - enterprise: require CS sign-off - partners/manual: manual only. Comms: banner at alias creation, email at 10% ramp, final confirmation 24h before switch. Offer migration tokens for self-serve and account credits for enterprise.
mira_csm: will draft tiered credit table: micro (token 25k), startup (50k), enterprise (invoice credit). Also add FAQ for re-pin and contract holes.
leo_sre: runbook additions: alias.create should create an Audit entry and a one-click revert that disables alias resolution and routes to previous model. Add dashboard per-alias with error-rate, latency, and sample fidelity metric.
dan_eng: dev tasks: alias resolver in router, shadowing instrumentation, migration-plan schema, UI for alias lifecycle + approval flow, billing credit hook. Est 3 sprints cross-team to MVP.
infra-bot: Note: next infra maintenance window 2024-06-02T02:00Z may affect routing rollouts.
zoe_pm: prioritization: flag as Q2 candidate for reducing customer friction in migrations and lowering immediate churn risk. propose pilot with 50 tenants mixed tier in June. I'll draft PRD this week with config templates and sample comms.
mira_csm: schedule CS pilot briefing. include rollback FAQ and finance contact.
dan_eng: will spike alias resolver and share proto.
leo_sre: will add alert rules and synthetic test harness.
zoe_pm: thanks team  closing and will post PRD link here when ready.
